text: B2a-r3: QB2-007 to QB2-011 read again; all were applied at B2b-r2-p2 and nothing of this leg rests on an assumption. Round 3 built in out/_packets-B2/round-3/ by out/_analysis/b2_packets_fleet.py (now reading the split layer through packets.py's Store with out/, and leaving out the six superseded parents): 98 items (44 unsplit, 54 children), seed 20261013, 7 self-contained packets of 10 to 15 items, 31,082 to 113,527 bytes of item text, fleet ids only (no room id in an id position), each MANIFEST entry with codes_by_item for fleet.py's citation check; shared pages from the edited scheme.jsonl; order in out/_analysis/b2_order_r3.json. RETURN-B2.md as at B2b-r2-p2 (fleet ids, the three-concept floor). run_manifest.json: a round-3 entry (same readers as round 2, deepseek-v4.1-flash direct, medium effort).

B2a-r3 close: round 3 built (98 items: 44 unsplit and 54 children; 7 self-contained packets with fleet ids and codes_by_item; seed 20261013; the six parents left out); RETURN-B2.md unchanged since B2b-r2-p2; run_manifest.json round-3 entry; validate.py B2: 0 errors, 444 warnings, pasted into notes-B2.md; head updated (2,981 words). Closing with done.sh B2 --cut packets-out.

B2a-r3-p2: J withdrew the split (2026-10-12, 12:04 to 12:10 Berlin): second-order themes are the coders' to cut; the aggregator takes them as given. out/recut/WITHDRAWN.json written; out/recut/ stays as written; mem.py split refuses. The 56 children's placement lines moved unchanged (out/_analysis/b2_split_withdraw.py) to out/_analysis/author_items_split_withdrawn.jsonl (54) and gold_items_split_withdrawn.jsonl (2); author_items.jsonl again holds 50 lines and gold_items.jsonl 40, as round 2 had them.

B2a-r3-p2: round 3 rebuilt on round 2's 50 items with fleet ids (out/_analysis/b2_packets_fleet.py, which now serves the parents again when out/recut/WITHDRAWN.json exists): 5 self-contained packets of 7 to 13 items, 89,418 to 135,742 bytes of item text, seed 20261013, codes_by_item in each MANIFEST entry; sweden t01 served whole as T2-08479 with its 310 concepts. The 98-item packets moved to out/_analysis/b2_packets_round3_split_withdrawn/ and their order to b2_order_r3_split_withdrawn.json. run_manifest.json: a round-3 entry superseding B2a-r3's.

B2a-r3-p2: J's 12:15 rule checked (fleet.py refuses a packet with codes_by_item if a room code or room theme id appears in its text, headings included). out/_analysis/b2_r3_roomid_scan.py scanned the 5 round-3 packets and the 22 shared pages: 0 room ids (the same pattern finds 50 in b2_order_r3.json). All 50 item headings carry T2- fleet ids; 4,094 concept lines carry C fleet ids.

B2a-r3-p2: notes-B2.md section 'The split, withdrawn' written: what was cut (six hard bags into 54 children, dankmemes t16 into 2), why J withdrew it, the records that belong to the withdrawn split (out/recut/, the two *_split_withdrawn.jsonl files, rechecks-B2.jsonl lines 888 to 1,413, 56 fleet_ids lines marked split, the 98-item round and its manifest entry, the cut scripts), what stands (round 2's scores, 16 waivers, edits 287 to 295 and their 133 rechecks, 31 confirmed pairs), and that round 3 is round 2's 50 items in 5 packets. validate.py B2: 0 errors, 443 warnings, pasted.

B2a-r3-p2 close: J's withdrawal applied (WITHDRAWN.json; author_items 50, gold_items 40; children's lines kept in _analysis; split records listed in notes-B2.md 'The split, withdrawn'; mem.py split refuses). Round 3 rebuilt on round 2's 50 items: 5 packets with fleet ids and codes_by_item, 0 room ids (J's 12:15 rule checked); the 98-item build kept at out/_analysis/b2_packets_round3_split_withdrawn/; run_manifest.json entry superseding B2a-r3's. validate.py B2: 0 errors, 443 warnings, pasted. Head updated (2,907 words). Closing with done.sh B2 --cut packets-out.
